purpose: The exact Hands generation head, lifecycle intents and immutable receipts, true-idle probes, the current-generation pointer a Brain activation reads, and a sharded evaluation due index for the reaper.

serverSideEncryption.rationale: Per-authority customer managed key. The table holds generation metadata only, never customer content.

globalSecondaryIndexes.name: gsi_runtime_due
globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: Sixteen shards over non-terminal generation heads. A dedicated due index rather than a regional-work item per evaluation, because the 180 second true-idle timer would otherwise cost a work-item rewrite per generation per evaluation; the index gives the reaper a bounded ordered scan at zero write cost between evaluations.

stream.rationale: The table holds no customer content, only generation metadata, so NEW_IMAGE is safe and gives the worker a state-change hint without a read.

timeToLive.rationale: Probes only, at 7 days. Receipts have no TTL: they are lifecycle evidence referenced by usage facts.
